import os, subprocess, pathlib, time, json, datetime, shutil, signal
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
scratch = root / '_scratch/mimo-round2'
evidence = root / 'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-round2'
profile = pathlib.Path('/tmp/aio-lt-queue-71493f81')
def record(event, **fields):
    with (evidence / 'runtime-receipts.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(dict(at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),event=event,**fields))+'\n')
assert not profile.exists(), 'Disposable profile already exists; investigate ownership'
target = profile / 'mimo-usage-sessions'
target.mkdir(parents=True,mode=0o700)
shutil.copy2(pathlib.Path.home() / 'Library/Application Support/harness/mimo-usage-sessions/legacy.bin', target / 'legacy.bin')
record('encrypted-session-copied',plaintextExported=False)
env = dict(os.environ, AIO_DEV_USER_DATA_PATH=str(profile), PORT='4579', NODE_ENV='development')
env.pop('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE',None)
children=[]
try:
    commands=[['node','_scratch/mimo-round2/server.cjs'],['node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron','--no-sandbox','--js-flags=--max-old-space-size=8192','--inspect=127.0.0.1:9823','.','--remote-debugging-port=9822']]
    for index, command in enumerate(commands):
        log=(scratch / ('runtime-'+str(index)+'.log')).open('w')
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        children.append((child,log))
        record('started',pid=child.pid,command=command)
        time.sleep(2)
    for _ in range(1200):
        if (scratch / 'stop').exists(): break
        if any(child.poll() is not None for child,_ in children): break
        time.sleep(1)
finally:
    for child,log in reversed(children):
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try: child.wait(timeout=20)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait(timeout=10)
        record('stopped',pid=child.pid,exitCode=child.returncode)
        log.close()

from pathlib import Path
import json,datetime
e=Path('docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-round2')
def read(name): return json.loads((e/(name+'.json')).read_text())['result']
first=read('rejected-refresh-one-fixed'); second=read('rejected-refresh-two-fixed')
network=read('rejected-network-fixed'); renewed=read('renewed-refresh'); walk=read('renewed-network')
age=read('stale-age-visible'); reused=read('persisted-session-refresh')
assert first['after']['needsReauth'] and second['after']['needsReauth']
assert first['after']['takenAt']==second['after']['takenAt']
assert first['after']['windows']==second['after']['windows']
assert first['after']['error']==second['after']['error']
assert second['reauthVisible'] and second['barCount']==2 and '⚠' in second['strip']
assert len(network['notifications'])==1 and network['notifications'][0]['delivery']=='desktop'
assert age['reauthVisible'] and age['barCount']==2 and age['ageMs']>=60000 and 'updated 1m ago' in age['row']
assert not renewed['reauthVisible'] and renewed['after']['ok'] and not renewed['after'].get('needsReauth')
assert renewed['after']['takenAt']>renewed['before']['takenAt']
requests=[r for r in walk['requests'] if r['phase']=='renew']
assert [(r['path'],r['status']) for r in requests]==[
 ('/api/v1/tokenPlan/usage',401),('/api/v1/tokenPlan/detail',401),
 ('/pass/serviceLogin',302),('/sts',307),
 ('/api/v1/tokenPlan/usage',200),('/api/v1/tokenPlan/detail',200)]
assert all(r['cookieOmitted'] for r in requests[:2]) and not any(r['cookieOmitted'] for r in requests[2:])
assert walk['persistence']['sourceUnchanged'] and walk['persistence']['isolatedBlobChanged']
assert json.loads((e/'renewal-log.json').read_text())['successLines']
assert reused['after']['ok'] and not reused['after'].get('needsReauth') and not reused['reauthVisible']
assert read('settings-restored')['restoredModel']=={}
for name in ['baseline-fixed','rejected-refresh-one-fixed','rejected-refresh-two-fixed','renewed-refresh','stale-age-visible','persisted-session-refresh']:
 focus=json.loads((e/(name+'.json')).read_text())['focus']
 assert not focus['hidden'] and focus['visibility']=='visible'
report=dict(at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),check2='PASS: real rejection; repeat cooldown failure preserves cached windows, warning, instruction, age; one desktop delivery',check3='PASS: real saved SSO redirects and quota retry; success log; warning cleared; rotated session persisted; original encrypted login unchanged',focus='visible for every DOM capture',settingsRestored=True)
(e/'acceptance-assertions.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Live evidence assertions passed for both previously open checks')

scripts.source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,time,datetime
state=json.loads((Path.home()/'.usage/state.json').read_text())['mimo']
observed=time.time()
with (Path.home()/'.usage/poller.log').open('rb') as f:
    f.seek(0,2);size=f.tell();f.seek(max(0,size-65536));tail=f.read().decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
success=[line for line in tail.splitlines() if 'mimo: ok (' in line][-4:]
result=dict(observedAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),updatedAt=state['updated_at'],updatedIso=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(state['updated_at'],datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),ageSeconds=round(observed-state['updated_at'],2),plan=state.get('plan'),attentionPresent=bool(state.get('attention')),windows=[{k:w.get(k) for k in ['label','used_percent','reset_at','detail']} for w in state.get('windows',[])],recentSuccessLines=success)
e=Path('docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-round2')
(e/'monitor-followup.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
assert 0<=result['ageSeconds']<=600 and not result['attentionPresent'] and success
assert result['updatedAt']>json.loads((e.parent/'2026-10-27/monitor-after.json').read_text())['mimo']['updated_at']
print('Current monitor reading is fresh and has advanced beyond the earlier observation')

scripts.name: diagnose-map.py
scripts.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib,json,datetime
p=Path('node_modules/@vitest/utils/dist/source-map/node.js')
original=p.read_text()
old='\tconst map = (convertSourceMap.fromSource(code) || convertSourceMap.fromMapFileSource(code, createConvertSourceMapReadMap(filePath)))?.toObject();'
new='\tlet map; try { map = (convertSourceMap.fromSource(code) || convertSourceMap.fromMapFileSource(code, createConvertSourceMapReadMap(filePath)))?.toObject(); } catch (error) { console.error("DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE_MAP_FILE", filePath); throw error; }'
assert old in original
try:
    p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
    result=subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy','python3','_scratch/mimo-round2/run.py','sea-map-diagnostic','rtk','proxy','env','AIO_TEST_SUMMARY=0','AIO_TEST_NO_CACHE=1','AIO_TEST_MAX_FORKS=1','npm','run','test:quiet','--','scripts/__tests__/sea-build-repeatability.spec.ts'])
finally:
    p.write_text(original)
    e=Path('docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-round2')
    (e/'diagnostic-instrumentation-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'temporaryFile':str(p),'change':'Log only the file path whose source-map parse throws; preserve and rethrow the original exception. No assertion, suppression or exit behavior changed.','restoredOriginal':p.read_text()==original,'restoredSha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
